programs.title: Selling Mega Mansions
programs.desc: Craig and his wife Olivia are looking at mansions in the Hollywood Hills section of Los Angeles with Hilton & Hyland's Camille Anderson.

programs.title: Find Me a Luxury Home
programs.desc: In California, Christine seeks to swap her desert lifestyle for a luxurious, fast-paced city life; she tours luxury homes in Brentwood and Pacific Palisades.

programs.title: Dream Purchase
programs.desc: Cher and Jim are looking for a boat that can host their adventures together. They navigate options from cozy cruisers to luxurious vessels to find a boat that matches their lifestyle and love for the water.

programs.title: Private Islands
programs.desc: Amber Wyatt visits Nihi Sumba, a retreat located on Sumba Island in Indonesia; combining exotic new luxury with a seemingly untouched island vibe, visitors rediscover themselves while letting all their troubles float away.

programs.title: Distant Shores
programs.desc: Paul and Sheryl Shard are on a diverse voyage from England through the inland waterways of France to the Mediterranean Sea, an Atlantic crossing and island-hopping in the Caribbean aboard their 49-foot sailboat, Distant Shores II.

programs.title: Global Passport
programs.desc: Join host Christina Cindrich in a winter wonderland and arctic adventure that is unlike any other experience on Earth. Finnish Lapland is filled with moments that combine surreal, magic, and mind-blowing into never to be forgotten memories.
